method: extract_scene_lights extract: local contrast (luminance minus a 21 px box mean, 3x3 smoothed); peaks >= 0.12 contrast and 0.7 luminance, 0.012 of the width apart; half-peak region 0.002..0.08 of the width across; contrast-weighted centroid; colour from the halo's added colour; warm hue test.
notProven: The detector proposes compact contrast peaks of the chosen hue; it cannot tell a lantern from a bright flower, sign, window row, wet-floor glint or reflection outside the stage's ground and water, and it misses a lamp no brighter than its surroundings. Look at lights-overlay.png, edit lights.json and re-bake it with the cookie verb.
Positions are glow centroids: a glow cut by an occluder or the plate edge pulls its centre.
Colour is the blob's hue at full brightness, radius and strength are presentation defaults; neither measures real emission or falloff.
The cookie is a screen-space tint texture, not light transport: everything under a pool gets the same tint.

checks.id: lights clear of the plate edge
checks.threshold: a glow cut by the edge pulls its centre inward
